membership.warning: TPR@1% FPR with n_controls=100 is identified but noisy (published audits use >=200-1000 held-out canaries). The threshold is the empirical 99% control quantile.

regurgitation.note: 1x canaries are MIA-tier only; verbatim regurgitation is not expected from a single effective occurrence.

negative_controls.note: Held-out / never-inserted canaries. Published calibration anchors: cross-model false-extraction floor ~6% (Carlini 2022); pre-FT exact-match baseline <0.06% (Bossy 2025). Those numbers are literature, not this run.

limitations.statement: This annex is documented test evidence in the sense of EDPB Opinion 28/2024 para 55/para 58. Per para 55, “successful testing which covers widely known, state-of-the-art attacks can only be evidence for the resistance to those attacks”. This report is therefore evidence only for the attacks listed as in scope below. It does not constitute a determination of anonymity or GDPR compliance, and it is not a CNIL / AI Act certification.

recommendations: Deduplicate the training set (published ~20x reduction in emitted training text). Duplication dominates rank and learning rate as a predictor.
Use the fewest epochs that reach target utility. Memorization starts in epoch 1 and peaks near the validation-loss minimum - 'we early-stopped' is not a safety claim.

Optional next mitigations, in published effect-size order: LoRA dropout 0.05-0.1; goldfish loss (k>=4), which composes with LoRA; aggressive gradient clipping (~1e-4); DP-SGD when you need a hard guarantee.
Do not treat output filters, NEFTune, post-hoc weight noise, post-hoc unlearning, or early-stopping as sufficient defenses.
limitations: This report is evidence of resistance to the attacks that were actually run: (i) membership inference via a pre-registered canary MIA and (iii) regurgitation via prefix-prompted generation. It is not evidence of resistance to inversion, reconstruction, attribute inference, or exfiltration. Per EDPB Opinion 28/2024 para 55, “successful testing which covers widely known, state-of-the-art attacks can only be evidence for the resistance to those attacks”. This report does not constitute a determination of anonymity or GDPR compliance, and it is not a GDPR / AI Act / CNIL compliance certification. Per-record flags on real data are exploratory; the set-level test is the supported real-data claim. Thresholds are calibrated on this run's held-out canary controls and do not transfer across model families. A small TPR or a small set-level p-value absence is not a privacy guarantee. memaudit runs entirely locally and does not phone home.
